integrity: The exact facet list is reconstructed independently; all 495 four-sets and all 390 tetrahedra are checked. Primitivity is certified integrally by an explicit cocycle with pairing plus or minus one on every missing tetrahedral sphere. Mod-two homology is used only as an independent consistency check.
scientific_limitations: Specific to Lutz's labelled triangulation (S3 x S2)^a_12. It does not classify the other known minimal twelve-vertex triangulations or larger-support representatives. The 57/48 sign split depends on the displayed orientation convention up to swapping signs.
title: All 105 missing tetrahedra are primitive shortest \(H_2\)-carriers in the minimal twelve-vertex \(S^3\times S^2\)
